_about: Who runs each Otari shop, as players see it. From the Player's Guide and the corrected pages in common/campaign-reference/players/. What each shop stocks is decided in bin/generators/generate_merchants.py (MERCHANT_CONFIGS). portrait is a known-good image URL or null.

otari_market.description: Large open-air market with diverse goods
otari_market.specialties: All adventuring gear, weapons, armor, and general supplies

wrins_wonders.description: Eccentric tiefling-elf oddities merchant and stargazer
wrins_wonders.proprietor: Wrin Sivinxi (CG female tiefling elf oddities merchant 5)
wrins_wonders.specialties: Magical items, spells, scrolls, staffs, spellhearts, runes, and alchemical potions

odd_stories.description: Fiction-loving wizard's bookshop with a three-story stone tower, and Otari's source of textbooks and teaching tools
odd_stories.specialties: Books (fanciful fiction and anthologies; his husband, Carlos, curates non-fiction and textbooks), formulas, arcane and occult scrolls, runes, and spellcasting

gallentine_deliveries.description: Courier and delivery service: Otari's post, in town and beyond
gallentine_deliveries.specialties: Package and post delivery, stabling, and transportation for caravans or carriages

blades_for_glades.description: Smithy for the lumber trade and adventurers alike
blades_for_glades.specialties: Metal adventuring gear, metal weapons, shields, and armor; saws, axes, and other lumber-trade tools

crows_casks.description: Two-story stone tavern and brewery, and a shrine to Cayden Cailean
crows_casks.specialties: Beverages, meals, alchemical items, potions, oils, and divine scrolls

crooks_nook.description: Tavern and inn built as a bridge over the Osprey River: best seafood in town, and the guildhall of the Osprey Club
crooks_nook.specialties: Beverages, meals, cheap lodging, illicit goods, thieves' gear, snares, and consumable items

the_rowdy_rockfish.description: The quietest and quaintest of Otari's taverns

otari_fishery.description: Fishery and pier by day; games, snacks, and entertainment on the ground floor by night
otari_fishery.proprietor: Tamily Tanderveil (NG female human harbor warden 3)
otari_fishery.specialties: Beverages, meals, transportation on sailing ships, fresh fish, and fishing supplies

dawnflower_library.description: Temple of Sarenrae, library and scriptorium
dawnflower_library.proprietor: Vandy Banderdash (NG female halfling cleric of Sarenrae 5)
dawnflower_library.specialties: Books, healing magic, religious items (including +1 favored weapons of Cayden Cailean, Erastil, Gozreh, and Sarenrae), divine scrolls, and runes
